hooks.command: echo 'RESPONSE STANDARD: every reply to the user follows the user-facing-communication skill. Open with what was done and the exact current state (committed, pushed, PR opened, reviewed and merged are different). Put anything outstanding, blocked or assumed where it cannot be missed. Name every issue and PR by number and title. Leave out investigation history, file lists and test names.'

echo 'WARNING: Off-workflow issue creation. Prefer /github-workflow:report-issue, which validates the body (--body-file), creates and verifies labels, attaches the current milestone, and handles Windows shell-escaping. If you are already inside the report-issue or execute skill, proceed.'

echo 'WARNING: Off-workflow PR creation. Prefer /github-workflow:execute, which validates the body (--body-file), applies the review-state entry label, releases the atomic claim, and sets the issue Stage to In Review. If you are already inside the execute skill, proceed.'
